summary: The M-sized feature has a proportionate test strategy: a pure production corpus oracle for precision, unit tests for deterministic decision branches and messages, real job/SQLite integration coverage for lifecycle effects, and no pre-deploy E2E because there is no staging and live publication is irreversible.
notes: Equivalent value-only title/acronym cases should be parameterized during task decomposition.
Integration assertions are required to verify queue, processed, deferral, and alert state rather than only mock calls.
The corpus integrity wave remains green; the target score is activated with the core implementation so no intermediate committed wave is permanently red.
